title.name: The showcase and what you leave with

overview.description: Not a pitch night — an immersive demonstration of the company, the data and the raise. The capstone is the assembly: everything the other forty-six nodes produced, in one package a stranger can evaluate without you in the room.
objectives: Assemble the deck, the data room, the demo and the follow-up into one package
Present science to a room that does not share your field and hold it
Convert showcase interest into scheduled meetings inside a week
Leave with the artefacts, not just the memory of the twelve weeks
prerequisites: Demo day preparation and pitch review
Diligence, data rooms and fundraising readiness

steps.intro: Not a pitch night — an immersive demonstration of the company, the data and the raise. The capstone is the assembly: everything the other forty-six nodes produced, in one package a stranger can evaluate without you in the room.
instructions: Assemble the package: narrative, deck, data room, TPP or roadmap, and the ask.
Have someone outside your field evaluate it with you silent in the room.
Rehearse the five questions you least want. Two sentences each.
Write the follow-up email before the showcase. Send it within 48 hours.

submission.description: Produce the Showcase Package and log it against this module in Homeroom. Done means the artefact exists, not that you read the page.
